proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab
  have hpos : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    rcases hab with h | h
    · have := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h
      positivity
    · have := sq_pos_of_ne_zero h
      positivity
  have hr : 0 < Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
  obtain ⟨α, hc, hs⟩ : ∃ α : ℝ, Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.cos α = a ∧ Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.sin α = b := by
    have hn : ‖(⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
      rw [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq_apply]
      congr 1
      ring
    have h1 := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
    have h2 := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg (⟨a, b⟩ : ℂ)
    rw [hn] at h1 h2
    exact ⟨_, h1, h2⟩
  refine ⟨α, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eq_div_iff hr.ne']
    linarith
  · rw [eq_div_iff hr.ne']
    linarith
  · intro x
    rw [Real.sin_add]
    linear_combination (-Real.sin x) * hc - Real.cos x * hs
target_source: ∀ a b : ℝ, (a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) → ∃ α : ℝ, Real.cos α = a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ∧ Real.sin α = b / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, a * Real.sin x + b * Real.cos x = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * Real.sin (x + α)
